title: Sinklit Totem
description: A silly resource pack that replaces the Totem of Undying with Louise and a cursed voice line.
body:
### Sinklit Totem Pack

This is a joke resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition that replaces the Totem of Undying with **Louise** – a character from the *Tochka Nevozvrata* series on **Lololowka's** YouTube channel.

When activated, instead of the default sound, you'll hear the iconic phrase:

> “OOOH, good **time** of day!!!”

Yes, it’s that cursed.


#### 📦 Features
- Custom Totem of Undying texture featuring Louise
- Custom activation sound ("OOOH, good time of day!!!")
- Lightweight and compatible with Minecraft 1.20+


#### 📸 Screenshots

![totem](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db062d0a61fbf51efaf3848b2f884bba67f2e77e.png)

#### ℹ️ Notes
- Designed for laughs, memes, and fans of the Sinklit universe
- No Optifine or mods required


👻 Made with confusion and love by **mrf0rtuna4**
